source.method: Cycle 34 frozen technical-document sections; retain heading plus a whitespace-bounded excerpt at most 512 UTF-16 code units. Repetitions are labeled and are not independent real documents.
source.limits: Single English technical self-documentation corpus, repeated excerpts and deterministic synthetic lexical controls; no representative traffic or relevance-quality claim.

costs.importedCode: Selected-source capture and copy-on-write directory staging; no phrase verifier.
costs.retainedRepresentation: One entry per record, present selected field and original value; selected original UTF-16 strings only.
costs.transientWork: Changed selected-field values and touched source-directory buckets; shared mutation budget.

costs.importedCode: Native analyzer, resumable source phrase verifier and selected-source protocol.
costs.retainedRepresentation: No additional index state; source providers retain declared originals.
costs.transientWork: At most 32 phrase-prefix entries plus one current token; complete lexical candidates are scanned under the shared search budget.
